meta.name: infinitetalk-shopping-avatar
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在制作数字人带货视频时，使用本技能可自动生成适配InfiniteTalk的五幕分镜结构化提示词，精准管控角色一致性与音画同步，一键产出高质量9:16竖屏带货视频，让数字人带货更高效！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成数字人五幕分镜，产出竖屏带货视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在运营电商或做内容,需要快速制作数字人带货视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate five-act storyboard prompts for digital human shopping videos.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run e-commerce or create content and need quick digital-human shopping videos.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为 InfiniteTalk 生成小省导购员带货视频的五幕结构化中文提示词和参数配置表，每幕 5s、共 25s、9:16 竖屏，并对提示词做质量核查、音频与参考图适配。
howto.when: 当你需要制作小省导购员数字人带货视频、用 InfiniteTalk 推理时触发；覆盖产品推荐、价格对比、促销活动等场景。

say.text: 帮我生成产品推荐场景的五幕提示词，情绪热情专业
say.note: 输出五幕中文提示词与参数配置表

say.text: 核查这组提示词的角色一致性、音频匹配和光影可实现性
say.note: 给出 pass/fail 质检报告和问题清单

say.text: 把 Suno 生成的 5s 音频对齐第一幕并做 wav2vec2 编码
say.note: 输出音频编码文件与对齐结果

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude generates five-act structured Chinese prompts and a parameter table for InfiniteTalk shopping-host videos: 5s per act, 25s total, 9:16 vertical, plus prompt quality checks and audio/reference-image adaptation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to make a shopping-host digital-human video with InfiniteTalk, covering product recommendation, price comparison, promotion scenes and more.

say_en.text: Generate five-act prompts for a product-recommendation scene, warm and professional tone
say_en.note: Outputs five Chinese prompts and a parameter table

say_en.text: Check these prompts for character consistency, audio match and lighting feasibility
say_en.note: Returns a pass/fail report and issue list

say_en.text: Align the Suno 5s audio to act one and run wav2vec2 encoding
